name: Disk safe cleanup
goal: Delete exactly the approved crash-leftover files (roleplaying-agents tmp_pack_*, index.stash.*, stale renamed index.lock, two named /private/tmp review JSONs; ~14 GB) with before/after evidence and read-only health proof.

tasks.name: Verify, delete, and prove health
tasks.description: Inline (destructive). Run human plan Task 1 Steps 1-10 exactly. Enumerate exact files (JSONs by exact name) -> strict-regex gate + manifest count equality -> precondition: lsof on every listed file (no handles, lsof_rc=1), no listed-pattern file modified <10 min, informative git-process listing with cwd (blocking if under roleplaying-agents or ~/.codex/worktrees/{a535,8735,8859}/roleplaying-agents), no live .git/index.lock; any failure = STOP, delete nothing, write note. Record df, count-objects -v, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 status; xargs -0 rm -f -- from list only (no rm -rf/unquoted globs/process kills); record df + count-objects after, prove listed files gone; fsck --connectivity-only --no-dangling as separate background run (timeout 1800000; errors pre-existing by construction); separate status diff. Write docs/reviews/2026-10-07-disk-safe-cleanup.md; stage with loop docs. Plan strengthens design D1 (open-handle + freshness). No tests required: operational cleanup verified by before/after evidence, count-objects, fsck.

steps.command: D=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-roberthyatt-Code-ironclaude/7c7f63a0-e272-4e34-a05b-3d6ebc128c94/scratchpad/disk-cleanup; R=/Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.git; mkdir -p "$D"; { find "$R/objects/pack" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'tmp_pack_*'; find "$R" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'index.stash.*'; find "$R" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'index.lock.inkarnate-stale-20261002'; find /private/tmp -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'inventory_preservation_plan_review.json' -o -name 'inventory_preservation_plan_review_fixed.json' \); } > "$D/delete.txt"; tr '\n' '\0' < "$D/delete.txt" > "$D/delete.list0"; xargs -0 ls -l < "$D/delete.list0" > "$D/manifest.txt"; echo "ls_rc=$?"; awk '{s+=$5} END {printf "%.2f GB\n", s/1e9}' "$D/manifest.txt"

steps.expected: no lines, nonmatch_rc=1, equal wc counts; else STOP

steps.description: Precondition (open handles, freshness, git procs, live lock)
steps.command: D=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-roberthyatt-Code-ironclaude/7c7f63a0-e272-4e34-a05b-3d6ebc128c94/scratchpad/disk-cleanup; xargs -0 lsof -- < "$D/delete.list0"; echo "lsof_rc=$?"; find /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.git/objects/pack -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'tmp_pack_*' -mmin -10; find /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.git -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'index.stash.*' -mmin -10; echo "fresh_check_done"; for p in $(pgrep git); do echo "pid=$p name=$(ps -p "$p" -o comm=) cwd=$(lsof -a -p "$p" -d cwd -Fn | grep '^n')"; done; echo "git_procs_done"; ls -la /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.git/index.lock; echo "lock_ls_rc=$?"
